name: Neon Plasma Chrono-Bloom
author: Jules
description: A hyper-vibrant, time-dilated explosion of neon plasma tendrils that bloom and interlace like a digital, cyberpunk flora. The field clock lags with radius so the bloom opens outward from the centre, and white-hot filaments ignite where two plasma sheet families cross. Hold the mouse to pull a gravity well that dilates time under the cursor; bass thickens the plasma, mids widen and treble heats the filaments.
